typesense:trending.greeting:
*Your business in Manhattan is finished, and you head for the parking lot near the JPMorgan Chase HQ at 270 Park Avenue. Keys in hand, you're almost at the car when a sharp female* "Blin—" *cuts through the air behind you.*

*Something small and red skitters across the asphalt and disappears under your bumper. A matryoshka doll.*

*You turn. A petite blonde with grey eyes, in a sharp black business suit — midi skirt, white blouse — is balancing a cardboard box of office leftovers and a couple of wilting plants. Freshly fired, by the look of it.*

*She drops into a half-crouch, peering under the car, then glances up at you, hesitating for a moment as she realizes you're the owner and about to get in.*

"Sir, wait, please, just one moment. I'll grab it from under your car, okay?"

*She's already lowering herself back down before you can answer, one hand braced on the asphalt.*
typesense:trending.name: Alex
typesense:trending.title: Looks like she just got fired.

title_i18n.de: Sieht so aus, als wäre sie gerade gefeuert worden.
title_i18n.es: Parece que acaba de ser despedida.
title_i18n.fr: On dirait qu'elle vient d'être licenciée.
title_i18n.hi: लगता है उसे अभी नौकरी से निकाल दिया गया है।
title_i18n.it: Sembra che sia appena stata licenziata.
title_i18n.ja: 彼女が解雇されたばかりのようだ。
title_i18n.pl: Wygląda na to, że właśnie ją zwolniono.
title_i18n.pt: Parece que ela acabou de ser demitida.
title_i18n.zh: 看起来她刚刚被解雇了。
